caption: H0: adders, multipliers and RAMs are fixed at the positions of the VPR analytic placer (vpr_ap, seed 1), as are the pads, in both external arms and for every seed. nextpnr therefore places only the LUT/flip-flop logic, around hard blocks and pads that VPR's analytic placer chose. The external arms inherit that part of VPR's solution; the annealing-family external arm inherits it from the analytic family. nextpnr has no timing model; both VPR families are timing-driven.
